_approach: The filter-sweep riser translated to drums: since a MIDI pattern can't automate a filter, the rising hat/shaker density and velocity ramp imitate the classic EDM noise-sweep riser underneath the house 4x4, with the kick and clap holding steady in bar 1 and thinning in bar 2 so the hat wash carries the "sweep" and the final 16th is left silent for the drop. Ref: EDMProd's build-up guide (the filter sweep as the number-one EDM tension device), Music Production Wiki's tension-and-drops guide. (re-voiced for the Vermona DRM1 MKIII's 8 channels)
